painted.label: Painted adventure
painted.prompt: Restrained hand-painted 1990s fantasy adventure item illustration, opaque gouache-like colour modelling, broad confident painted planes, sparse dry-brush marks, selective dark accents along occluding contours. Tactile and believable without photographic microtexture. Slightly irregular handmade edges, clear original local colours and quiet wear; descriptive rather than ornamental. Smoothly drawn high resolution shapes, no square pixel clusters.

inked.label: Inked dark fantasy / UI kin
inked.prompt: Inked dark-fantasy illustration with a tight palette: economical dark-brown contour and broken interior ink accents, flat-to-painted natural local colour, rough-edged gouache highlights and controlled hatching in the deepest shadow. The tone should sit beside weathered-stone and brass game UI without turning the object into stone or adding fittings. Strong silhouette, readable middle tones, antique craft rather than polished digital fantasy.

gouache.label: Warm storybook gouache
gouache.prompt: Old illustrated fantasy bestiary and adventure-book gouache, gentle warm/cool colour interplay within the object's original colours, opaque layered brush shapes, softly worn paint and delicate dry-brush edges. A tactile quietly charming handmade object with simple modelling and a few fine descriptive accents. No black comic outline, no paper background, no ornamental manuscript border and no invented decoration.

etched.label: Tinted engraving
etched.prompt: A restrained antique fantasy equipment engraving with fine broken umber contour, short directional crosshatching that wraps the existing volumes, and opaque muted natural-colour washes. Preserve the object's tan or gold local colour rather than turning the image sepia or monochrome. Readable large shapes before line texture; use very little hatching in lit areas, no surrounding page, border or typography.

collection_rules: Make this belong to one coherent set of grounded, slightly timeworn fantasy adventure inventory art. Keep the source's local colours: do not tint every material brown or add brass simply to match the UI. Use a restrained palette with distinct light, middle and dark families, clear silhouette and legible material masses. Detail hierarchy: silhouette first, a few large planes or folds second, sparse material marks third. Keep the original class of mundane object, its opening and visible components; no extra handles, gemstones, runes, faces, symbols, chains or elaborate fantasy embellishment. Do not convert this into pixel art, a photoreal product photograph, a glossy mobile-game loot icon or a dramatic scene. No text, labels, border, vignette, decorative frame, hand, person, pedestal, scenery or second object.
presentation: One isolated item on a perfectly flat solid dark slate grey background, RGB 48,52,59. No floor, no background texture and no cast shadow outside the object. Full object visible with breathing room, centred. Longest extent roughly three quarters of a square canvas. Preserve the source view and rotation. Broad soft light from the upper left, restrained highlights and readable shadow planes. Draw actual new fine forms with clean deliberate edges rather than smoothing or retaining square source pixels.
title: Inventory icons batch F (remaining sprites), part 1 (furniture, quest and religious items)
selection: Batch of unique world sprites from the full icon conversion (rusty-dagger #10458). Each sprite is generated once; sharing is stated in its uncertainty text.

items.name: Lantern (18x38)
items.content: One hanging lantern, aspect about 0.47:1. A tall narrow dark metal lantern with a small ring at the top, a pointed cap, thin dark frame bars and glass panes glowing warm yellow-orange from a bright flame inside, on a small dark base. Preserve the tall narrow shape and the glowing panes. No chain, text, smoke or hand.
items.uncertainty: The glow is interpreted as a lit candle behind glass panes. Sprite shared by: item-248-lantern.
items.invention: Resolve metal bars, glass panes with warm glow and a simple cap.

items.name: Boots (48x27)
items.content: One pair of dark leather boots lying together, aspect about 1.8:1. Two black-green boots with tall shafts, one standing at the upper right and one lying on its side at the lower left, with brown soles and straps at the ankles. Preserve the pair of boots and the dark colouring. No feet, legs, text or buckle ornament.
items.uncertainty: Which boot is which and strap details are interpretations. The sprite is shared across clothing templates recoloured in engine. Sprite shared by: item-108-boots.
items.invention: Resolve leather creases, soles and plain straps.

items.name: Glass Bottle (10x25)
items.content: One empty glass bottle standing upright, aspect about 0.4:1. A tall narrow teal-blue glass bottle with a short neck and rim at the top, a bright pale highlight at the middle and a dark empty interior. Preserve the narrow tall shape and the highlight. No cork, label, liquid, text or hand.
items.uncertainty: The bottle is interpreted as empty glass. Sprite shared by: item-083-glass-bottle.
items.invention: Resolve glass thickness, a restrained highlight and a plain rim.

items.name: Small Chest (33x29)
items.content: One small closed chest, aspect about 1.15:1. A wooden chest in warm brown with a rounded teal-green lid, a metal lock plate at the front left and a checkered brown front. Preserve the box shape, rounded lid and lock plate. No gold, text, open lid or extra chains.
items.uncertainty: The checkered front is interpreted as woven or banded wood; the green lid is kept as a patinated top. Sprite shared by: item-090-small-chest.
items.invention: Resolve wood grain, simple metal bands and a lock plate.

items.name: Wakizashi (29x62)
items.content: One short Japanese sword standing upright, aspect about 0.47:1. A slim dark blade pointing down-left with a small round pommel at the top right and a dark grip, no visible guard detail. Preserve the narrow diagonal shape. No scabbard, text or hand.
items.uncertainty: The orientation is a diagonal near-vertical lie. Sprite is shared by several weapon templates recoloured in engine. Sprite shared by: item-117-wakizashi, item-118-broadsword, item-119-saber, item-120-longsword, item-122-claymore, item-123-dai-katana.
items.invention: Resolve a steel blade with a faint edge highlight, a wrapped grip and a plain pommel.

items.uncertainty: The red mark is interpreted as a small dried bloodstain. Sprite shared by: item-116-shortsword.

items.name: War Axe (45x12)

items.invention: Resolve metal plates, a rim and faint scratches.
